subject: drv.interaction.overtaking
item: divergence 1 (fails_wrongly) at t=2000 ms: After starting behind b in the same lane within the lookback window, a has passed b and is now wholly ahead in an adjacent parallel lane. The contract excludes — contract: holds, body: fails; contract: "at this observation the first either overlaps the second along the lane axis or is ahead of it"
reason: The contract expressly excludes the lane used for passing from what it denotes, so "is ahead of it" cannot require the same lane; on the executed facts a started behind b in lane 10 within the 2 s window, headings are identical, and at t=2000 a is ahead of b, so the contract holds while the body's same-lane ahead-behind atom fails — a change in what the contract denotes, not a choice among its meanings. — "Not denoted: ... the lane or part of the road the passing road user uses, and which side it passes on"
situation: After starting behind b in the same lane within the lookback window, a has passed b and is now wholly ahead in an adjacent parallel lane. The contract excludes the lane used for passing, but the body's ahead alternative requires the same lane.
contract_words: at this observation the first either overlaps the second along the lane axis or is ahead of it
